findings.claim: Index entry format undefined. Resolved: the plan defines which index, what an entry is (list item, first relative link to a page in that folder or below, prototype README.md), and the three writer plans cite it.

'Does not repeat the validator' conflicted with checking .okf/ entries. Resolved: kmctl checks .okf/ entries itself because it does not run the validator; only front matter and spec conformance are left to the validator.
Root index count unaddressed. Resolved: kmctl neither writes nor checks counts; the repo's okf-bundle rule still mentions counts and adapt-copied-rules rewrites it.
